description: Make a Gate project match an odile.yaml: creates the project (if no project_id) and missing apps and approvers, applies run mode, loop, learning and anomaly-guard settings and alerts. Example plugin: {name: anomaly-guard, settings: {mode: alert, z_threshold: 4, min_minutes: 3, half_life: 60}}. Never revokes or deletes; differences it cannot apply (an app's routes or rate limit) come back as drift. dry_run lists the steps without changing anything. New keys are shown once.

admin_key.description: Its admin key (ga_...), required with project_id. Read it from the .env; never print it.

config.description: The whole odile.yaml (or the same as JSON) as text

dry_run.description: List the steps without changing anything

project_id.description: Optional: an existing project to sync

name: gate_sync_declarative
title: Apply an odile.yaml
